title: MZ HIT AN ENEMY WHEN HE HITS ALLY?

posts.author: mike_312
posts.body: Does anyone know how I can make a character hit an enemy when the enemy hits an ally? I use RPG Maker MZ and the Visustella plugin.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: One way I think is to use VS Auto Skill Triggers and make Physical/Magical/Certain Hit Opponents conditions and make them launch a skill with an action sequence that checks last target actor Id and if that's the dude and not ally, then it skips the whole skill sequence.
